real: Boxer 8x8 drive module (unit_refs: Boxer / Stryker) with a field-emitter mission module; M2 Browning 12.7 mm RWS
shape: unit_sheet.json: an 8-wheeled vehicle carrying a domed / metal shield emitter with a glowing ring in the team colour; from above a glowing round disc in the middle of the hull; about 6.3 x 2.4 x 1.9 m (0.8 x the Boxer chassis) plus the emitter (modelSize 2.84 m tall); visible weapon M2 Browning 12.7 mm; team stripes on the roof and both sides; no real insignia.

features.feature: the tall faceted Boxer hull (Team) with the V belly and the two-step glacis
eight wheels on four axles in two pairs, wishbones, axle beams, fenders and mud flaps
the driver's hatch and periscopes front left; the engine louvres and exhaust front right
vision blocks, mirrors, lamps, the rear ramp door with hinges, handle, steps and tail lamps
the field emitter: finned drum, three prongs, reflector dish, glowing Team ring and core
the power cabinet with its grille and cable runs
the remote 12.7 mm station on a raised ring, its sensor head (Turret)
smoke dischargers, the side stowage bin, a crate, a net roll, whip, Team bands
